Disposition-derived bounded attempt probability and verified complete command/member evidence

courtRules.structuralRequirements: Original living sovereign/formal active state, recent real national crisis, existing legal adult royal target, annual boundary and 60-month cooldown. Only NO_CURRENT_VULNERABILITY may be absent at initiation.
courtRules.armyQualification: Same permanent person, User, valid official appointment, unique active complete command and actual members; court-only eligibility allows >=12 service months and >=2 members without requiring verified captures. Other military political/secession qualification is unchanged.
courtRules.will: Original willingCourtParticipant is retained; redundant ambition > loyalty hard gate is removed.
courtRules.probability: Official medium: clamp(0.05 + ambition*0.0008 + (100-loyalty)*0.001 + min(3,actual strength)*0.01, 0.04, 0.25). Existing test-only low/high scales remain; no per-general lottery.
courtRules.success: Original complete eligible deposition opportunity and original success interval still required. Without current vulnerability, a real attempted challenge can fail but cannot produce a formal deposition even at roll zero.
courtRules.random: Exactly one shared political draw per evaluated qualified country opportunity, mutually exclusive with old deposition path. New opportunities may legitimately consume additional draws compared with z37. Existing RNG state and cooldown are saved.
courtRules.failure: Real dismissal/disbanding, sourced attempt/result/command-end IDs; no execution or implied stripped honor.
courtRules.successIdentity: Existing legitimate royal becomes ruler, supporters remain distinct; existing actual military royal can reuse the exact same body, birth and lifespan. No ordinary residents or new formations are created to make a coup work.
courtRules.save: V2 attempt record preserves independent success eligibility/blockers and actual member snapshots. V39 rejects V38 or earlier slots without overwriting them.

baselineFunnel.notes: Political and army branches intersect; 33 and 30 are separate branch denominators, not successive monotone stages. Blocker counts in per-seed records overlap.

natural.laterChanges: Read-only honor/category UI, documentation/version labels and stricter rejection of duplicated frozen member IDs; no political decision code changed after the verified run.

natural.frequencyConclusion: Eligibility increased, but an actual natural event-rate improvement has NOT been demonstrated. No conditional success/failure rate can be estimated with zero attempts. No assertion of the 40-100 world-year design target is made.
natural.funnelComparability: Baseline command/willing observations include all crisis+target boundaries; candidate command/willing counters apply after structural guards. Compare qualified instigator opportunities and actual sourced events directly; do not interpret 43 versus 28 as a same-denominator army change.
natural.safety: All per-seed strict saves, zero unexplained population/person/formation/history conflicts and deterministic 12-month continuation/second read passed.
natural.discardedRun: Initial candidate archive used moving HEAD and raced an external manual commit; it still contained z37 rules. Its results are excluded. The corrected archive pins a single commit hash, copies diffs against that same hash, and verifies decision-file bytes/SHA256 before running.
natural.extraSampling: No added seeds, 200-year or 500-year runs. Fixed transaction scenarios are not counted as natural events.

presentation.honors: Only existing canonical dated grants. Country/rank/name prominent before accession; monarchy remains primary after accession and old honor is labeled 登位前. Dead/ended-house/exiled states are explicit. Peerage and posthumous epithets are separate.
presentation.estate: Grant-time identity and last effective window use original source order. Later honors, accession/foreign flags and loss-period developments are not backfilled; histories remain lazy/windowed.
presentation.capital: No regex truncation. Shared political formatter plus matching frozen city ID/name proves the capital is already rendered; actual other capital changes and exile context remain.
presentation.category: REBEL/FRONTIER/SPLIT all display 义军 while internal enum/origin, probabilities and saved historical events remain intact.
